cards.front: What does a baby need to grow?
cards.back: Food, water and care from its family.

cards.front: Which comes first: a child or a baby?
cards.back: A baby. A person is a baby first, then a child, then an adult.

cards.front: When you grow, what happens to your body?
cards.say: When you grow, what happens to your body? You get taller and bigger.

cards.front: Do adults keep getting taller?
cards.back: No. People stop growing taller when they are grown up.
cards.say: Do adults keep getting taller? No. People stop growing taller when they are grown up.

cards.front: What do a hen and her chicks do?
cards.back: The hen keeps her chicks warm and safe.
